# What is this delayed job really worth, claim against liquidated damages?

> Free construction delay claim calculator: sort delay days by cause, see the time extension you earn, the compensable cost with an Eichleay home-office share, and the liquidated damages left. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
